name: Pásztó (Hungary)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly into a black upper fly part and a white lower hoist part, charged at the centre with the town arms of Pásztó: a crowned white shield with a black-robed figure.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
